boundaryMethod: Following-text alignment; verse cuts placed in the middle of low-energy recording pauses.
notes: The opening Om is part of the invocation. The audio edition removes the unrecited additional Om from mantra 1.1 only; the original HTML remains unchanged.
Recitation wording and phrase grouping follow the recording-specific review; grammatical word division remains in Study.
The recording repeats the invocation and ends with Hariḥ Om; both are retained in a closing card.
Single daṇḍa । marks an internal recitation pause; double daṇḍa ॥ marks the end of a verse or invocation.
